Task: Silicon bulk minimisation for Surface Energy - Level 1

1. Set up the simulation parameters

Action Input: {"path": "/results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_surface_1_bulk_energy_minimisation_trial_2/in.minimize", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Si bulk minimization

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Si_structure.data

# Define potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * Si.sw Si

# Replicate the system
replicate 5 5 5

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Output final energy
variable natoms equal count(all)
variable etotal equal pe
variable bulk_energy equal ${etotal}/${natoms}

# Print energy per atom
print "BULK_ENERGY=${bulk_energy}" file energy.txt

# Write relaxed structure
write_data relaxed_structure.data"}
